rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Fetches and parses web content with browser-grade TLS fingerprint impersonation using curl_cffi. Provides 9 focused tools: raw HTML fetching, cleaned readability text extraction, JSON API requests, link extraction with CSS/regex filtering, HTTP header inspection, metadata extraction (JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter Cards), HTML table parsing, RSS/Atom feed parsing, and concurrent bulk URL fetching. All tools are read-only with output truncation and centralized error handling.
